knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 5.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) State Bayes' theorem for events A and B. (2) What one simple conditional does 5.1.1 require you to update? (3) Name one reason this does not finish prior/posterior (5.1.2).
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Bayes' theorem updates P(A|B) from P(B|A), P(A), P(B). Today is theorem/conditionals. Prior/posterior/conjugate are tomorrow.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 5.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Fraud screen: P(fraud)=0.02, P(flag|fraud)=0.90, P(flag|genuine)=0.05. A claim is flagged. (1) Compute P(fraud|flag) via Bayes. (2) Refuse: 'P(fraud|flag) equals P(flag|fraud)=0.90.'
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) P(flag)=0.90·0.02 + 0.05·0.98 = 0.018 + 0.049 = 0.067. P(fraud|flag)=0.018/0.067 ≈ 0.269. (2) Refuse: that equates posterior with likelihood and ignores the base rate. Bayes multiplies prior × likelihood and normalises.
